# Sorokyne Strata (LV-976)
[italic]Date 2186 - Sorokyne Strata. A major Union of Progressive People's research outpost in the Neroid Sector.[/italic]
[bold]Sorokyne Strata[/bold] is a research and mining outpost on the frozen world LV-976, in a sliver of contested neutral space between the [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"] (UPP) and the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"] (UA) in the Neroid Sector.
## History - LV-976 was discovered by an automated probe in 2112. Colonization rights were claimed by several parties, among them [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"], which sent a colony ship in 2152. - The outpost was founded in 2163 and gradually expanded with a second, mining outpost and permanent housing for its research staff. - From 2171 its efforts turned to terraforming the vast network of thermal tunnels running through the planet's crust. The colony is estimated to be worth billions.
## The Colony - The research outpost is staffed mostly by Weyland-Yutani contractors and UA colonists, while the mining outpost is worked mostly by UPP contract labor. - Construction and security were contracted to [bold]Sestra Solutions[/bold], a UPP-aligned firm. - With workers from rival powers living side by side, tensions are never far below the surface.
## LV-976 LV-976 orbits a dim red dwarf, which keeps it bitterly cold, though terraforming has made parts of it more livable. Its gravity is about a quarter stronger than Earth's. Its only neighbor is a barren, irradiated rock with no atmosphere.
